title: Ku kashe shi, ku saya, ku sayar da shi da gaskiya, sannan ku yi shirin gaba
course_title: Maganin Kiwon Lafiyar Halitta: Man shafawa na asali, man shafawa da mai

say: Ku kashe shi, ku saya, ku sayar da shi da gaskiya, sannan ku yi shirin gaba.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module huɗu na Kulawar Fata na Halitta.
Creams suna kallon arha don yin, saboda yawancin tulun ruwa ne. Amma emulsifying kakin zuma, abubuwan adanawa, marufi, tambura, gwaje-gwajen dakin gwaje-gwaje da gwaje-gwaje suna ƙara sauri.

say: Sabbin ƙera da yawa suna yin kwafin farashin wasu, kuma daga baya sun gano cewa suna asarar kuɗi akan kowace tulu. Farashin naira a cikin wannan bidiyon kusan misalan aiki ne kawai. Yi amfani da farashin akan rasidun ku.

say: Fara da farashin kowace gram. Raba abin da kuka biya ta gram ɗin da kuka karɓa. Idan g 500 na emulsifying ya kai naira 8,000, wato naira 16 gram.

say: Man fuska kishiyar man shafawa ne. Babu ruwa, don haka mai shine mafi girman farashi.
Jojoba akan naira 90 gram daya yana zuwa 1,215. Babba, 486.
Rosehip, 421, da bitamin E, 22.

Jimlar man fetur din ya kai kimanin naira 2,145. Ƙara kwalaben amber, lakabin, sanitizer, rabin sa'a na aiki da gwaji, kuma farashin kwalban kusan 3,895. A kaso 40 cikin 100, farashin ya kai kusan Naira 6,500.

Idan farashin ku ya fi wasu nisa, nemi tanadi mai aminci. Sayi kwalba da kakin zuma da yawa da zarar tsarin ku ya wuce gwajin kwanciyar hankali, kuma ku yi manyan batches don haka aiki kowace tulu ta faɗi.
Kuma ƙidaya batches da suka gaza. Idan bashi ɗaya cikin goma ya ɓace, wannan yana ƙara kusan kashi 10 cikin 100 akan kuɗin ku.

panel.heading: Inda za a ajiye, inda ba za a

say: Amma kar a taɓa ajiye kuɗi ta hanyar yanke abin adanawa, tsallake gwajin pH, ko amfani da ruwan famfo.

panel.heading: Inda za a ajiye, inda ba za a

say: Amsa tambayoyi da gaskiya. Idan abokin ciniki ya tambaya ko zai sauƙaƙa fatarta, a ce a'a. Yana da wani moisturizer da rike fata taushi. Idan ba ka ƙirƙira ko gwada ta ga jarirai ba, ce ba za ka iya ba da shawarar ta gare su ba.

panel.heading: Kare abokan ciniki da kuɗin ku

cards.d: Shin zai sauƙaƙa fatata? A'a, kayan shafa ne. Ba a gwada jarirai ba, don haka ba a ba da shawarar ba.
Sai kawai daga adana, gwajin batches, a cikin tukwane masu lakabi. Babu yatsu a cikin masu gwajin nuni.
Bincika kuɗin da suka isa bankin ku ko aikace-aikacen walat ɗinku kafin mikawa. Za a iya yin karyar hotunan hotunan.

say: Ba da samfura kawai daga batches da aka adana, kwanciyar hankali, a cikin tsaftataccen tukwane. Kada a taɓa sayar da kirim ɗin da aka zubo cikin nailan mara lakabi ko sake amfani da shi.

say: Aikin ku fayil ne na samfur: dabara, takaddun bayanai, rikodin tsari, log ɗin kwanciyar hankali, ra'ayi, lakabi da farashi, tare da tunani na gaskiya. Misali, Ifeoma a Onitsha tana da maganin shafawa wanda ya wuce makonni 8 na kwanciyar hankali, da kuma man fuska wanda ya wuce 12.

say: Don tunawa. Ƙididdige marufi, aiki da gwaji, ba kawai kayan abinci ba. Farashi ta hanyar raba farashi da ɗaya ban da gefen ku. Kar a taɓa yanke aminci don rage farashi.
Amsa da gaskiya, samfurin tsafta, kuma tabbatar da kowane biyan kuɗi a cikin app ɗin ku.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Ƙidaya marufi, aiki da gwaji
Farashin = farashi ÷ (1 - gefe)
Kar a taɓa yanke aminci don rage farashi
Amsoshin gaskiya, samfurori masu lakabi
Tabbatar da biyan kuɗi a cikin app ɗin ku

say: Yanzu farashin man shafawa na kanku da man fuska, ƙirƙirar jeri na gaskiya don duka biyun, kuma ku haɗa fayil ɗin samfurin ku tare da shirin kwanaki 90.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
